items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: Al was interviewed in New Hartford, NY on June 8, 2017, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Al was interviewed in New Hartford, NY on June 8, 2017, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to be talking to Dr. Albert Vollmer after a long time waiting to do so. Hamilton class of ’52, right?
